Name: DBB's Victorian Gothic User Interface
Author: donutbunnybunny
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=3]Changes the interface to a Victorian Gothic theme.

You can mix and match the interface with your desired colors.
However, some colors (especially bright colors) or certain color combinations may not be very readable.

There is a delay of a few seconds when changing settings.

I have not been able to check for missing UI images or visual bugs. If you find any missing images or bugs, please let me know.

[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b]Q. My[/b] Tailoring and Dye Menu are blue![/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[b]A. [/b]Blue UI is not a bug. It's hard-coded. This is something I cannot change. The same applies to the forge menu on Ginger Island.

[b]Q. [/b]I set the base color to Soft Brown, but sewing machine color is black!
[b]A. [/b]This is intentional. So do not report this as a bug.

[b]Q.[/b] Do you have any plans for Remixed Bundle, Raccoon's Requests, Island Field Office, Forge UI?
[b]A.[/b] Remixed bundle images are planned to be updated in the future, while others may be updated, but this is not certain.

[b]Q.[/b] Can you make a mobile version too?
[b]A.[/b] Not planned.
Most of the assets are shared between PC and mobile, but some are used separately for mobile.
I didn't prepared any assets for mobile because I can't test them myself.
When creating the UI, I need to determine the range of the sprites through testing and verify how they look in the actual game.
Even if someone is willing to provide screenshots, it is challenging to create the UI based solely on screenshots. Sorry!

Q. The bird on the title screen does not turn into a butterfly.
A. Occurs when a mod like Stardew Valley Expanded was installed. I'm not looking to do anything for this.
